sources.name: Open-Meteo.com
sources.note: MeteoSwiss ICON models; aggregated by city and hour

fields.hour_local: Hour start, Europe/Zurich wall-clock time, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm
fields.is_weekend: Saturday or Sunday (local); public holidays not included
fields.data_status: ok, missing, partial, glitch_known or glitch_suspected; rules in the header of city.sql
fields.is_imputed: TRUE when docked_bikes is interpolated because data_status is not ok
fields.docked_bikes_raw: Sum of bikes docked at the hour start (first snapshot) over reporting stations; NULL if missing
fields.docked_bikes: Cleaned docked bikes: raw value when ok, else linear interpolation between neighboring ok hours
fields.bikes_out_est: Estimated bikes out of docks = fleet_baseline_bikes - docked_bikes; uses future hours, display only, not a forecasting feature
fields.bikes_out_provisional: TRUE for the last 12 hours of data: baseline may still change as new hours arrive
fields.bikes_out_share_of_peak: bikes_out_est / bikes_out_peak_recent_7d, 0 to 1; the animation draws 9 bikes at 1
fields.n_stations_active: Stations whose bike count changed during the hour (count at the next hour start differs from this hour start)
fields.share_stations_active: Share of stations with activity during the hour, 0 to 1: raw value when valid, else linear interpolation; NULL at the edges
fields.is_activity_imputed: TRUE when share_stations_active is interpolated (share_stations_active_raw is NULL)
fields.temperature_c: Air temperature at 2 m at the hour start, deg C (city weather cell)
fields.precipitation_mm: Total precipitation during the hour, mm (rain + snow water equivalent)
fields.precipitation_kind: snow if snowfall_cm > 0, rain if precipitation_mm >= 0.1, else none
fields.cloud_cover_pct: Cloud cover at the hour start, percent
fields.weather_code: WMO weather code at the hour start
fields.weather_is_forecast: TRUE when the weather values are still a forecast (after the latest weather pull)
fields.sun_elevation_deg: Sun elevation above the horizon at the hour start, degrees (negative = below)
fields.light_phase: day (elevation > -0.833), twilight (to -6) or night, at the hour start

not_shown_reason: station data not fresh enough: stations report too rarely to show an hourly pattern

not_shown.note: Stations report rarely (median 15.7 h since last report, counts change in 8% of station-hours), so the daily pattern is not visible
